title: When does symbolic regression add to tower micrometeorology? Code and results
description: Code, result tables and figure scripts for the article When does symbolic regression add to tower micrometeorology? Eight equation-discovery methods tested on known laws and on an Amazonian flux-tower record (submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software). Eight equation-discovery engines (PySR, Operon, gplearn, SINDy, DSO, PhySO, AI Feynman, KAN) and the AI-Lorenz pipeline are tested on ten micrometeorological laws, two dynamical systems and an audited flux-tower record from Rebio Jaru, Rondonia, Brazil. Every table and figure can be rebuilt from the saved results without rerunning the engines. Raw data are not included; see the README for sources.
